scenarios.name: Severe Supercell & Squall Line Outbreak
scenarios.description: Rapidly organizing multicellular convective cluster with peak reflectivity of 58.5 dBZ, overshooting tops at -72°C, and cloud-to-ground lightning frequency of 42.8 strikes/min.

scenarios.name: Early Afternoon Convective Initiation
scenarios.description: Boundary layer convergence over elevated terrain initiating growing cumulus congestus. High CAPE (>2800 J/kg) with first flash detected.

scenarios.name: Dissipating Anvil Shield
scenarios.description: Cold pool outflow dominating; convective downdrafts causing cell collapse and transition into stratiform light-to-moderate rain.
